verdict.rationale: The xAI API lets Grok reason over your own data: it can search uploaded knowledge-base collections and attached files through an agentic attachment_search workflow, run Python code for analysis, and query your data via tool calling. Structured outputs make the results machine-consumable. Missing for 10: an in-product end-user insights or suggestions surface (results come through API calls you integrate yourself), and independent or hands-on corroboration of data-insight quality.
